system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Tracks the status of a specific PM-KISAN installment for the farmer. For your information, my aadhaar_number is 100020005076.

function.name: pmkisan_track_installment_status
function.description: Tracks the status of a specific PM-KISAN installment for the farmer. Returns installment_status ('due', 'processed', 'credited', 'failed') and reasons for any failure. Installments may fail if eKYC is not completed, bank details are invalid, or eligibility is not confirmed. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT process or trigger payments — it only reports status. Fails if the farmer is not registered or has no active installments.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

installment_number.description: Installment number to query (1, 2, or 3 for the respective installment of the financial year).

financial_year.description: Financial year for the installment query, e.g., '2024-25'.
